record.tooling: OpenAI-compatible SDKs and HTTP clients; models.dev lists the provider as package @ai-sdk/openai-compatible with 17 models.
record.chaining: An OpenAI-compatible endpoint swaps in with a base-URL change; free endpoints benchmark production H100/H200 behaviour, and paid serverless uses the same API, so a workload can move from free to paid without changing code.

record.binding_note: On the free endpoint the 1,000,000-token-per-minute Tier 1 ceiling binds before any byte quota, because no free token allowance or egress cap is published and the next tier needs a credit purchase.

The measured keyless GET /v1/models answered 401 API key is required, so a key from the account is needed to call the API.
